remarks: Discover an exceptional opportunity to BUILD YOUR DREAM HOME on this BUILDABLE LOT resting on nearly 25 acres of beautiful, varied countryside in Holland, NY. A picturesque blend of rolling meadows, mature woods, winding creeks, and scenic ravines creates a remarkable natural setting offering both tranquility and endless possibilities for outdoor enjoyment. Flowing waterways meander through the property, revealing striking rock formations, secluded wooded pockets, and a charming small waterfall that adds to the peaceful atmosphere. Open fields transition into established woodland, creating a wonderful balance of expansive views, privacy, and natural beauty. Abundant wildlife makes this property especially appealing to hunters, hikers, campers, and anyone who appreciates the outdoors, with deer, wild turkey, and native blackberry growth among its many natural features. Take in beautiful sunsets across the open landscape, enjoy the changing scenery with each season, or spend quiet mornings exploring the trails and creek beds. Whether envisioned as a recreational getaway, private nature retreat, or simply a place to enjoy the freedom of wide-open space, this unique property offers a chance to experience the best of the Western New York countryside. Electric available at the road. A semi-established entrance provides direct access to this expansive parcel of connected fields, wooded terrain, creeks, and trails.  All Buyers MUST be accompanied by their agent.  DO NOT walk the lot without first scheduling a showing.  Wear “hiking” appropriate attire. Showings begin immediately. Seller asks all offers be submitted no later than 11AM on Thursday, October 22,2026.
